prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your injuries, the complexity of the liability/fault issues, whether you need a trial lawyer, and your personal preferences (big-firm vs. boutique, local reputation, communication style, etc.). I can, however, point you to well-regarded options and give practical tips to pick the best lawyer for your situation.

Well-known Chicago personal-injury firms (examples, not an exhaustive endorsement)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Levin & Perconti
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Goldberg Weisman Cairo
- Power Rogers & Smith

How to choose the right attorney
- Experience: look for lawyers who focus on car-accident and catastrophic-injury matters and who regularly try cases.
- Track record: settlements/verdicts in cases like yours.
- Reputation: peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers listings, client reviews.
- Resources: ability to hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, etc., if needed.
- Communication: responsiveness and clarity about strategy and fees.
- Fee structure: most PI lawyers work on contingency (common rates ~33%–40% plus costs); confirm details in writing.
- Comfort level: you should feel confident and comfortable asking questions.

Questions to ask at a first consult
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- What outcome do you expect for a case like mine?
- Who will handle the case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and how are costs handled?
- How will you communicate updates?

Practical next steps (if you’ve been injured)
- Seek medical care immediately and follow treatment.
- Preserve evidence: photos, video, witness names, police report.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without an attorney.
- Be aware of Illinois’s statute of limitations for personal injury (generally 2 years from the crash date).

If you want, I can:
- Compile a short list (3–5) of top-rated Chicago attorneys with contact info and recent results, tailored to your ZIP code and the severity/details of your case.
- Suggest specific questions to ask during consultations or help evaluate offers if you get multiple settlements.

Tell me your ZIP code and a brief description of the crash/injuries and I’ll pull a tailored shortlist.
